attorneys: Petitioner pro se., C. Watson Hover for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion for leave. to file petition for writ of certiorari is denied. Treating the motion as a petition for writ of certiorari td the Supreme Court of Ohio, certiorari is denied without prejudice to an application for a writ of habeas corpus in the appropriate United States District Court. Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
